description: This Java source file defines the UserService class, which manages user creation, retrieval, and update operations in a microservices-based internet banking system. It interacts with Keycloak for identity management, a repository for data persistence, and external REST clients for banking core integration.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class responsible for user management operations including creation, retrieval, and updates, integrating with external identity and banking services.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in the system after validating the email and banking identification, integrating with Keycloak and banking core services.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users from the database and enriches user data with details from Keycloak.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Fetches a single user by ID from the database.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user's status and enables the user in Keycloak if approved.
